post.summary: Signs a portal user in. Returns a short-lived access token and a rotating refresh token.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. The presented token is revoked; reusing it revokes the whole session.
OAuth2-style client credentials for API clients. The token carries tenant_id, client_id and scopes.

get.summary: The plan as machine-readable entitlements (what a license issued from it grants).

post.summary: Makes a published trial or free plan the one currently offered for its product.
Issues a license. The response is the only time the full product key is returned.
Replaces the product key (e.g. after a leak). Releases every device; the new key is returned once.
Creates a client. The secret is returned once and stored hashed.

get.summary: Revenue and running subscriptions per month of a year (granularity=monthly) or per year (yearly).
Public keys that verify offline license tokens (active and retiring). Clients cache this and select by kid.

post.summary: Rotates the license-signing key. The previous key keeps verifying (status "retiring").

Activates a device. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request returns the original result
instead of consuming another activation.
Checks a license for an activated device. Served from a short-lived cache that is invalidated on any status change.
Periodic check-in. Always reads the database and returns a fresh signed token.

Starts this device's one trial of a product, on the product's published plan with trial days. The product key is in the
response only this once; a device that already had a trial gets `LIC_TRIAL_USED`.

Gives this device the product's current free plan. The product key is in the response only this once; a device that
already has its free license gets `LIC_FREE_USED`.

get.summary: Serves an uploaded image. Ids are random, so the URL can be used directly in <img>.

put.summary: Any signed-in user can set their own photo.
